answer: A single Brine keeper brine pan proof countersigned by the salt assize does the work of a whole committee: each brine pan is a season of logged brine readings plus a signed salt record, so a, verified by a stranger. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 579 fakes need 579, at 116 POA each, totalling 67164 POA. The delta is written in ink, the jade is written in POA, and the wander is written in the register's own hand. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
